Settings.title: Account
Settings.timezoneDescription: Used to schedule your availability and timestamp bookings.
Settings.themeDescription: How the app looks on this device.

Workflows.description: Trigger emails or webhooks when bookings change.
Workflows.deleteDescription: This stops the trigger immediately. Existing reminders that have already fired stay sent.
Workflows.listEmpty: No workflows yet. Add one to send reminders or fire webhooks on booking events.

ApiKeys.description: Tokens for scripts and integrations. New tokens are shown once.
ApiKeys.createDescription: Give this key a name you'll recognize later, then pick the scopes it should carry. You can revoke it anytime.
ApiKeys.scopesDescription: A token can carry at most the scopes your role grants. Pick the smallest set that does the job.
ApiKeys.revealedDescription: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again — losing it means rotating the key.
ApiKeys.revealedHint: Treat this like a password. Anyone with the token can act on the workspace within its scopes until you revoke it.
ApiKeys.revokeConfirm: Any integration using it will start getting 401s.
ApiKeys.noKeysEmpty: No keys yet. Mint your first key to authenticate scripts, CI, or third-party tools against this workspace.
ApiKeys.noWorkspaceEmpty: No workspace yet. API keys are scoped to a workspace — create one first, then come back to mint a key.

Calendar.description: Block your availability with busy events from external calendars.
Calendar.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No calendars selected} one {# calendar selected} other {# calendars selected}}
Calendar.providerNotConfigured: Provider not configured — set the env vars to enable.
Calendar.pickDescription: Busy events on the calendars you select count against your availability. Unselected calendars are ignored.

DangerZone.label: Danger zone
DangerZone.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently removes your handle, weekly hours, profile, and any upcoming bookings. Booking history is anonymized and retained for audit. There is no undo.
DangerZone.dialogIntro: This permanently deletes <handle></handle>, your weekly hours, and any upcoming bookings against your page. Booking history is anonymized and retained for audit. There is no undo.
DangerZone.dialogTypeEmail: Type your account email {email} to confirm.
DangerZone.emailMismatch: Email does not match the account email
